name: Luminance-GS (CVPR 2025)

parts.gsplat (bundled): Luminance-GS/gsplat: the repository's own copy of gsplat 1.0.0's CUDA backend, with rasterization.cu and _wrapper.py changed (channel counts 5, 9, 17, 33) and rendering_double.py added; it is JIT-compiled from these sources (gsplat itself is NOT pip-installed: a pip gsplat would be imported first by _backend.py and lacks those kernels)
parts.glm: not vendored: gsplat 1.0.0's submodule pin g-truc/glm @ 45008b225e28eb700fa0f7d3ff69b7c1db94fadf (git ls-tree of nerfstudio-project/gsplat v1.0.0), fetched by methods/luminancegs/setup_kaggle.sh and copied into csrc/third_party/glm by the adapter (the repository lost the submodule)

changes: exported with git archive; only what simple_trainer_ours.py needs to train and render with the default (LOM 'low') loader: README.md, Luminance-GS/{LICENSE, README.md}, examples/{simple_trainer_ours.py, utils.py, tools.py, losses.py, requirements.txt}, examples/datasets/{colmap.py, normalize.py, traj.py}, gsplat/rendering_double.py, gsplat/cuda/ (Python and csrc). Not copied: docs, assets, pics, profiling, tests, setup.py, simple_trainer_3dgs.py, simple_viewer.py, image_fitting.py, tools_decompose.py, datasets/colmap_mip360.py (only for --exp_name variance), gsplat's other modules (rendering.py, cuda_legacy, ...): rendering_double.py imports cuda/ alone
runtime_patches: applied by methods/luminancegs/adapter.py on a COPY: 'from turtle import color' removed from simple_trainer_ours.py (unused; turtle needs tkinter); examples/datasets/__init__.py added (empty) so the Hugging Face 'datasets' package cannot shadow this namespace package; glm copied in. See methods/luminancegs/README.md
